decisions.statement: How many bytes one answer has is stated here.
Three other files state that count of their own.
A run begins after the line the caller names as already reached.
A line already reached past the last line begins the run at the first line.
A run has every further line the answer has room left for.
A run names the line the run begins at.
A run names the line the run ends at.
A run names how many lines the body has.
A run ending at the last line says the whole body reached the reader.
A run ending short of the last line says nothing past that line reached the reader.
A call for the next run is handed back only where a line is left over.
The call for the next run is priced as the widest line number the body can hold.
A refusal for a line too wide names that line and its bytes.
A line number is no part of the body.
Nothing here writes to the record of the bodies an agent read.
A reader that dropped the lines an earlier run handed over is judged here.

definition: a body longer than one answer handed back a run of whole numbered lines at a time
